metadata.source: European Commission JRC / Copernicus EMS Global river flood hazard maps v2.1.2
metadata.interpretation: Long-term modelled riverine hazard, not a 2026 seasonal forecast, property-level probability, pluvial flood map, observed depth, or calibrated prediction. Annual probability bands are reciprocals of the sampled return periods, under model assumptions. Positive depth >=0.1 m assigned to lowest sampled return period; bands are bounded by sampled scenarios, not exact cell probabilities.
metadata.masks: Cells flagged 1 in permanent-water or spurious-depth rasters excluded. Mask no-data 255 treated as no supplied flag, not a depth observation. Absence of a displayed cell is not evidence of safety.
metadata.processing: Small raster windows read from official GeoTIFFs, clipped to study rectangle; adjacent cells of equal class merged horizontally without changing grid class boundaries.
license_notices: Linked copyright.txt licenses the dataset CC BY 4.0; attribution and changes retained
